# Descriptions
@@ 1
Causes d10 concussion hits of damage.
@@ 2
Causes one muscle to cramp in the target. Target will be at -10% to activity
per 10 failure.
@@ 3
Target will bleed at the rate of 1 hit per round.
@@ 4
As Wounding I, except does 3d10 concussion hits of damage.
@@ 5
One external sensory organ (eye, nose, ear, etc.) is damaged. Foe will operate
without that organ until healed. In addition, he will have a -10 modification
per 10 failure to all actions that partially use that organ (-100 for all
actions involving that organ directly).
@@ 6
One of target’s limbs suffers a minor fracture.
@@ 7
As Bleeding I, except target bleeds for 3 hits per round.
@@ 8
As Wounding I, except does 5d10 concussion hits of damage.
@@ 9
As Sensory Damage I, except 2 organs are affected.
@@ 10
The area touched by the caster on the target is paralyzed.
@@ 11
As Wounding I, except does 7d10 concussion hits of damage.
@@ 12
Target is drained of d10 Temporary Constitution points. If target’s
Constitution drops to 0 or below, he becomes a Class I Created Undead.
@@ 13
Target loses 1 hit per round that the caster concentrates (and remains within
2' of the target). As each point is drained, the caster is restored 1 point
(up to his maximum).
@@ 14
As Bleeding I, except target bleeds for 5 hits per round.
@@ 15
As Wounding I, except does 10d10 concussion hits of damage.
@@ 16
As Energy Drain I, except drains 2 hits per round.
@@ 18
As Drain Soul I, except drains 2d10 points and target becomes a Class II
Created Undead if Constitution drops to 0 (or below).
@@ 20
As Wounding I, except does 15d10 concussion hits of damage.
@@ 25
As Drain Soul I, except drains 1 point per level of the caster and target
becomes a Class III Created Undead if Constitution drops to 0 (or below).
@@ 30
As Bleeding I, except target bleeds for 1 hit for every 5 levels of the
caster.
@@ 50
As Wounding I, except target loses all his hits and takes an additional 1 hit
for each level of the caster.
